verdict.rationale: Zulip publishes public API documentation at zulip.com/api, with a 'Send a message' endpoint, and documents an API-based framework for writing and running interactive bots. That shows first-party programmatic control exists. However, the pack evidences only one endpoint, and probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec, llms.txt, or markdown docs at the tested paths, so the breadth of API coverage for driving the product is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of broad endpoint coverage (channels, topics, search, users), a discoverable OpenAPI spec, AI-friendly docs (llms.txt or markdown), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Zulip’s API has a powerful framework for interactive bots that react to messages in Zulip. You can write and run a custom bot, or run an existing Zulip bot.
